clv.note: CLV implied pts = close_implied - bet implied_probability (same percent units). Positive ⇒ close was a worse price than the bet. Interpret close_source: pregame_snapshot_best_odds is NOT book close.

blockers.live_espn: Live ESPN NFL scoreboard is optional and may return 403 from sandboxed egress; prefer --provider nflverse or --boxscores fixtures.
blockers.event_id_join: Outlier event_id does not match ESPN/nflverse provider ids; join is team-pair + Eastern slate date + player name.

model_p_note: model_p = Laplace(α=2) shrink of empirical L10→L20→L5→season hit rates; source=empirical_hit_rate_laplace. Never copied from implied_probability. Raw empirical (pre-shrink) Brier was 0.238 on this slate.
shrink_grid_note: Holdout grid on 2026-09-20 only (no prior settleable Sunday pack on box): α∈[1.5,12] beat market Brier 0.209; α=4 minimized (~0.199). Default α=2 is pre-specified add-2 smoothing (model Brier 0.2048) to avoid locking the single-slate peak.
